title: Glowing UFOs spotted racing over the Atlantic at 'hypersonic speeds'
excerpt: Mysterious glowing orbs were reported by a ship crew crossing the Atlantic Ocean this month. They described multiple UFOs moving at 'hypersonic speeds' over the vessel.
content:
Sailors have reported a mysterious sighting as they crossed the Atlantic this month.

A submission to the National UFO Reporting Center (NUFORC), dated October 11, detailed an encounter with glowing UFOs that the ship's crew said moved at impossible speeds and patterns.

For about 40 minutes, two sailors watched through binoculars as a single orb appeared 12 to 16 miles away, which 'rose and fell rapidly, bearing right and left, periodically shooting at hypersonic speeds, for about 5-10 minutes.'

The report, posted on October 21, claimed that three or four more orbs appeared, which looked the same as the first.

'All twisting and turning, rising and falling together in no set pattern,' the report states.

'Every so often they went somewhere else altogether, at a speed I can only call unreasonable, and then were simply there again. 

'We picked up no targets on the radar.'

The NUFORC report included screenshots of the boat's radar, reportedly taken during the encounter, showing nothing on the screens that would suggest objects were in the sky.

A submission to the National UFO Reporting Center (NUFORC), dated October 11, detailed an encounter with glowing UFOs that the ship's crew said moved at impossible speeds and patterns - but did not show up on the boats radar (pictured)

The witness said the encounter began around 3:25am, when the ship’s second mate spotted a strange light low above the horizon, slightly to the left of the vessel’s bow.

The ship was crossing the Atlantic roughly 400 miles south of Nova Scotia, heading east at about 20mph, according to the report.

The witness described clear skies with only a thin crescent moon, saying ‘visibility was great.’ 

The vessel was not noticeably rocking, and there was ‘no traffic whatsoever’ nearby.

After seeing the first orb, the sailor said: 'The others appeared, 3-4 more. They were like the first in every respect.'

Another startling NUFORC report was submitted last year, featuring a video showing a clear image of what one witness believes was a giant UFO flying over California.

The April 27 video taken by an unnamed resident in Twentynine Palms followed what appears to be a brightly-lit hexagonal craft as it flew over the desert.

The report, posted on October 21, claimed that three or four more orbs appeared, which looked the same as the first. The witness shared screenshots of the radar to show no objects in the sky when they saw the UFOs

The UFO reportedly appeared out of nowhere around 10:27 pm PT while the witness was staying at a remote cabin.

According to the report, the suspected spacecraft was moving very slowly and irregularly, like it was in a daze.

'It seemed to move arbitrarily with no clear path. The movements were jerky and at varying speeds,' the witness wrote in their NUFORC report.

The large object also appeared to pulsate, giving off a bright light from its edges, as it moved through the sky for approximately 15 minutes.

'Tonight is the new moon - so it was definitely not the moon, and in any case was much brighter than even a full moon,' the witness continued.

'The striking thing was its great brightness and irregular shape and path,' they added.

Another startling NUFORC report was submitted last year, featuring a video showing a clear image of what one witness believes was a giant UFO flying over California 

As the witness in Twentynine Palms followed the UFO, they added that the strange craft began to change shape - morphing from a six-sided object into a circle.

The person taking the cellphone video was the only witness at the cabin that night, so no one else was able to confirm their story.

However, they declared in their report to NUFORC that they hadn't taken any 'mind-altering substances' during the sighting and had clear vision the entire time.

Officials at NUFORC tried to find an explanation for the sighting, noting that a SpaceX rocket launch had taken place that day, but that Falcon 9 took off from in Florida three hours earlier.

A previous rocket launch created a similar phenomenon over the UK in March.

That bizarre shape was caused by illuminated frozen fuel expelled from the SpaceX rocket, experts revealed.

The light blue spiral is formed when excess fuel that has been released from the fast-spinning rocket turns to ice.

It then reflects sunlight in the upper atmosphere, giving it an otherworldly gleam before becoming water vapor.
